<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market performance and crude impact:</strong> Indian indices experienced a volatile session, initially finding support from a decline in crude oil prices before facing late-session selling pressure led by IT stocks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi__?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>

  <li><strong>Rupee and economic outlook:</strong> The RBI has flagged volatile crude oil prices as a primary pressure point for the Indian rupee, even as the broader economy continues to demonstrate resilience against global geopolitical risks and trade tariffs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Global market sentiment:</strong> International markets are currently focused on upcoming US corporate earnings, specifically from the technology sector, alongside anticipation of key inflation data releases.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Commodity price movements:</strong> Gold prices experienced a correction, snapping a four-day rally with a decline of ₹600 per 10 grams due to profit booking, while silver prices saw a partial rebound.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
